bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Released - New build 26220.7535 enhances accessibility features with AI-powered image descriptions.
Xbox Developer_Direct Returns - Anticipation builds for the January 22 broadcast showcasing upcoming games.
Enhanced Cyber Resilience Services - New proactive incident response services introduced to bolster organizational security.
Phishing Attack Vector Explored - Microsoft details how complex routing is exploited for domain spoofing in phishing campaigns.
Introducing Defender Experts Suite - New expert-led services launched to enhance cybersecurity resilience and operations.
NVIDIA Rubin Platform Integration - Microsoft’s Azure ready for seamless deployment of NVIDIA’s next-gen AI infrastructure.
Osmos Acquisition Announced - Microsoft acquires Osmos to enhance autonomous data engineering capabilities in Fabric.
